status: exploratory application development; controlled protocol unchanged
facts: Generate atomic claims from six-paragraph chunks; validate typed states and source spans; same-model full-paragraph entailment audit.
coverage_review: At most four generated missing claims per undersized schema, one bounded review; reject untraceable candidates; apply the usual semantic gate.
graph: Generated chronological relevance ordering, then generated direct parents among eligible earlier states; maximum four parents; outcome sees the complete frozen packet.
temporal_scope: Researcher-supplied outcome endpoints in outcome_endpoints.json; no researcher-supplied explanatory variables or edges.
retention: Keep outcome ancestry. Report fewer than ten nodes as a size-target shortfall; never connect context to fill a quota.
equations: Per-node typed ASTs over formal parent slots; root identity from explicit background; no internal residual; prior accepted local rules shown for conditional alternative synthesis.
validation: Typing, bounded evaluation, active parents, factual compatibility, DAG and recorded episode order; independent semantic truth is not established.
repairs: At most two per artifact per recorded protocol. Multiple exploratory revisions are preserved and do not constitute a held-out literary test.
alternative_budget_gate: Complete one admissible model for every case before additional alternatives; defer extra alternatives once the server has generated 850000 tokens.
attribution_refinement: Exact enumeration for final application collections of at most eight paths; preserve original permutation estimates.
evidence_policy: Unsupported/unassessed status has effective score zero; preserve raw scores and ranking sensitivity. Evidence scores do not change equations.
final_reviews: Same-model source critique and full-text explanation-to-trace audit; neither is independent human review. Failed explanations are withheld from display.
selection: Corrected complete-outcome evidence protocol, independent of node count or numerical result; first accepted alternative by index is principal. Earlier candidates remain archived.
